Austin is probably called a "naive empiricist" because he conceives of laws pragmatically rather than conceptually. He treats law as observable facts, such as commands backed by sanctions and a habit of obedience to a sovereign, instead of analysing what law is as a concept. I'm choosing this over the "anachronistic model of a legal system" option from the team note, but I'm not sure of it, and I couldn't trace the phrase to a specific source.

CONFIDENCE: 50
